testcase.name: Scenario: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard: tmp/obk-bdd-project-wPhRV5Dm/checkout/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:103:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard ✔ Given the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active project with Folder Options and Options groups is displayed ✔ When the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group ✔ And the user presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets ✔ When the user presses the Left Arrow key ✔ Then the Folder Options children are hidden ✔ When the user selects the collapsed Options group ✔ And the user presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names ✔ And the active project remains marked in the project list
